feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 28 May 2026 4:25am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 28 May 2026 at 4:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

A few showers at first this morning, which could be thundery, will soon clear northwards leaving the rest of the day dry, with sunny spells at first but becoming cloudier mid to late afternoon, and with the risk of mist/fog patches along some coasts particularly in the south. Top temperature around 20°C, fresh southeast winds gradually veering southerly and decreasing for a while in the afternoon.


##Outlook##

Dry on Friday with spells of sunshine and moderate to fresh southwesterly winds. Top temperature 19°C.

Saturday will start off dry and bright but soon turn cloud as a spell of rain arrives early afternoon for a time, before clearing away later in the day. Light to moderate south or southwesterly winds will gradually increase through the day to become fresh to strong for the evening and with top temperatures of 16°C.
